h1: Dornbracht bathroom installation in Gerrards Cross

hero.intro: Gerrards Cross sits around 25 to 30 minutes from our Bracknell base, which makes it one of the more straightforward parts of our patch to reach — but getting to site easily doesn't make a Dornbracht installation any more forgiving once we're there. Dornbracht is a German brassware house known for sculptural handle and spout design and finishes that are genuinely difficult to replicate elsewhere, and the tolerance for error is small: a scuff on a brushed Dark Platinum finish, or a rough-in set a few millimetres out, is far more visible — and far more expensive to put right — than on a mainstream product. We fit Dornbracht brassware across Gerrards Cross on a fit-only basis: you source the product from a showroom or retailer, we strip out, first-fix, tile, plumb and fit it to the standard it demands, from £3,500.

sections.heading: What Dornbracht brings to a Gerrards Cross bathroom
sections.body: For homeowners in Gerrards Cross specifying through a showroom or designer, Dornbracht tends to turn up where the brief calls for brassware that reads as sculptural rather than standard — taps, mixers and shower valves with a handle and spout design built to be noticed, in finishes that are genuinely difficult to replicate elsewhere. It's a considered choice rather than a default one, and fitting it well means treating the brassware as the focal point it was specified to be, not an afterthought bolted on once the tiling's finished.

sections.heading: The finish is the hard part, not the plumbing
sections.body: Installing Dornbracht brassware doesn't call for different plumbing skills to any other brand — the pipework, valves and connections behave the same way. What changes is what happens if something goes slightly wrong. A scuff on a brushed Dark Platinum tap body or a rough-in set a few millimetres out of position is far more visible, and far more costly to correct, than the equivalent slip on a mainstream brand. On a Gerrards Cross job that means confirming the exact Dornbracht spec at survey stage, before any wall closes up, and sequencing the fit so the finished brassware is handled as little as possible once it's in.

sections.heading: Fit-only across Gerrards Cross
sections.body: We install luxury, fit-only bathrooms for homeowners across Gerrards Cross and the surrounding Buckinghamshire area close to Beaconsfield and Chalfont St Peter. You source the sanitaryware, brassware, tiles and furniture — including any Dornbracht brassware you've specified — and we strip out, first-fix, tile, plumb and snag, from £3,500. That model works well with a design-led brand like Dornbracht, because the quote reflects the fitting complexity honestly rather than bundling in a retail margin on the product.

sections.heading: Booking a survey
sections.body: A £125 survey comes before any quote, and it's where we confirm the exact Dornbracht products specified, check the rough-in dimensions against the manufacturer's installation detail, and plan the sequencing so the finish isn't put at risk by later trades. With 30 years' experience fitting bathrooms across Berkshire, Buckinghamshire and Surrey, that's the stage where a Dornbracht installation gets planned properly, not discovered on fitting day. For a Gerrards Cross project that's already been through a showroom or designer consultation, the survey is also where we cross-check the designer's drawing against what's actually buildable — confirming wall thickness is sufficient for a concealed valve body, or that a specified basin position leaves enough clearance for the tap's spout reach — rather than finding a clash once the Dornbracht product itself has arrived on site.

faqs.q: Is fitting Dornbracht more involved than fitting a standard brassware brand?
faqs.a: The plumbing is no more complex, but the margin for error on finish and rough-in accuracy is smaller, so we plan the installation more carefully at survey stage to avoid marking the finish or setting a valve out of position.

faqs.q: Can I buy Dornbracht brassware myself and have you fit it?
faqs.a: Yes — that's exactly how our fit-only model works. You source the Dornbracht product from a showroom or retailer, and we handle the strip-out, first fix, plumbing and fitting.

faqs.q: How far is Gerrards Cross from your Bracknell base?
faqs.a: Around 25 to 30 minutes by road, which keeps logistics straightforward for a Gerrards Cross installation.

faqs.q: What does the £125 survey cover for a Dornbracht job?
faqs.a: We confirm the exact Dornbracht products specified, check rough-in dimensions against the manufacturer's detail, and plan the fitting sequence before any quote is issued.

faqs.q: Do you repair Dornbracht brassware after it's fitted?
faqs.a: Yes, repairs start from £200, with a £500 minimum for an emergency call-out. We don't offer standalone regrouting.
